title: Nous Research Targets Full Public Launch of Hermes AI App After Thanksgiving
summary:
The official mobile version of the Hermes AI agent will move out of restricted testing for a wide release in late November. Nous Research plans to provide more beta seats to users before Christmas to address the high demand that filled all available slots for the iOS and Android trials shortly after they launched Oct. 31.

The software serves as a client for Nous Cloud or self-hosted gateways, incorporating a voice-based Live Mode and terminal access via SSH and Mosh. Initial testers gave the application a 4 out of 5 rating, citing a solid dashboard and an easy setup process.

selectedTweets.text:
Hermes Mobile got a 4/5. But almost no one got into the beta.

The official app from Nous Research dropped on October 31 for iOS and Android. It’s a client for your own gateway (self-hosted or Nous Cloud).

What’s inside:
- Chat with visible tool calls
- Live Mode (voice + pause = send)
- Routines to Telegram/Discord/Slack
- Skills, MCP, plugins, Kanban, spend tracking
- Terminal over SSH/Mosh

People who got in are mostly positive. One user said they used to work through Telegram and haven’t opened it since installing the app. 

@tonysimons gave it 4/5: easy setup, solid dashboard.

But most replies are about access. The Android tester limit filled immediately, and the TestFlight link returns 404 for a lot of people. They’re asking for “gib access” and “drop the APK.”

Waiting for proper access to the Hermes Agent mobile app.
